name: vision-harness
description: A small, authorization-aware toolkit for project vision, onboarding, agent instructions, and delivery planning.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project goals, authorization, and delivery context intact.
interface.longDescription: Vision Harness helps an Agent form a usable project vision, reuse existing project facts, maintain local instructions, and turn accepted goals into concrete delivery planning without creating a parallel project database.
defaultPrompt: Clarify this project's vision before planning.
Onboard this repository without duplicating its facts.
Turn this accepted vision into the next delivery batch.
